notes: Valid X API v2 operators only (recent-search / search/all). Web-only operators (since:, min_faves:, filter:blue_verified) are not used.
Bare $ is a cashtag operator in v2, not a dollar-sign match. Price intent uses phrases like sold for / USD / thousand, then the local parser extracts $25k etc. from text.
start_time / end_time are request params, not query operators.
from: accepts a username (or numeric user id once resolved). Collector also builds from: queries from data/accounts.json.
Recent-search query max length is 512 chars (self-serve). Keep each query well under that.
'closed' + domain is noisy (sports, real estate, shops). Kept last and marked noisy.

queries.query: "just sold" (domain OR domains OR #domains OR #domain) -is:retweet lang:en
"sold for" (.com OR .ai OR .io OR #domains OR domain) -is:retweet lang:en
queries.why: Price + TLD / industry tag. Parser pulls the USD amount from text.

queries.query: "domain sold" (USD OR thousand OR "sold for") -is:retweet lang:en
queries.why: Sale language plus currency words. Avoids the v2 cashtag operator.

queries.query: sold (.com OR .ai OR .io OR .net OR .org) (USD OR thousand OR k) -is:retweet lang:en

queries.why: Brokers often say closed rather than sold.

queries.query: closed domain (USD OR thousand OR "sold for" OR .com) -is:retweet lang:en
queries.why: User-requested 'closed' + domain + price. Noisy — sports/shops/leases. Parser + later review.

queries.query: ("namebio" OR NameBio) (sold OR sale OR "sold for") -is:retweet lang:en
queries.why: People cite NameBio comps when announcing or discussing sales.

queries.query: (escrow OR "escrow.com") ("domain sold" OR "sold the domain" OR "just sold") -is:retweet lang:en
("acquired" OR purchased) (domain OR .com OR .ai) (USD OR thousand OR "sold for") -is:retweet lang:en
(from:DomainNameWire OR from:DNJournal OR from:NameBio OR from:DomainSherpa OR from:MichaelCyger OR from:AndrewAllemann) (sold OR sale OR closed OR "sold for") -is:retweet lang:en
queries.why: Timelines of core industry accounts, sale-filtered. Usernames from accounts.json.

queries.query: (from:GoDaddyAuctions OR from:Escrow_com OR from:Afternic OR from:Sedo OR from:NameJet) (sold OR sale OR closed OR auction) -is:retweet lang:en
queries.why: Marketplace / escrow accounts that post completed sales or auction results.
